name: Tabcorp API MCP Server
description: Enables comprehensive interaction with Tabcorp betting services through 30+ specialized tools covering racing data, sports betting, results, and FootyTAB with OAuth authentication. Supports all Australian jurisdictions and provides access to race meetings, next-to-go events, form guides, jackpots, and sports competitions.
